entries: Satellites: launch weather, comms, navigation and survey satellites from a launch pad, read them at a ground station, and find your way with a GPS receiver.
Docking ports let other parties visit your space station, by invitation or open to everyone, and carry parcels between stations.
The microgravity lab grows electronics, advanced bruise packs and rough diamonds aboard a sealed, powered space station module.
Ground stations belong to the party that first launches a satellite to them; rivals can break in to take one over or cut a satellite's link.
A satellite whose link was cut can be reacquired by its owners at their ground station.
